📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Norman Kelleher. Sign painter. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Seed packet, Contract Quill, Photo album, Boot stone, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night,
A person, maybe 30s, with deep-set eyes: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
